say:0:1623464001:0.text: Is that Olaya? Let's go talk to her!

say:3:1623467003:1.text: She avoids eye contact instinctively. It's nothing like the sharp, confident Olaya everyone knows.
say:3:1623467003:1.source_cn: 她下意识地避开了目光接触，这与平日那个锋芒毕露的她判若两人。

say:4:1623467004:1.text: Bel asked you to come, didn't he? People won't stop talking about you.
say:4:1623467004:1.source_cn: 是巴布邀请你来的吧？我听到很多学生在讨论你。

say:5:1623467005:1.text: Yeah. He invited me... and next time I'm supposed to go on as a guest.
say:5:1623467005:1.source_cn: 嗯，是巴布邀请我的……下一次研讨会，我会作为嘉宾出席。

say:6:1623467006:1.text: You know his article's got a lot of made-up stuff in it. Why would you go along with this?

choice_prompt:7:1623467006.text: You know his article's got a lot of made-up stuff in it. Why would you go along with this?

say:8:1623467007:1.text: You're still the same, Reeo. Always lecturing the first chance you get... Yeah, they messed up. But they already paid for it, and it wasn't some slap on the wrist. It's the kind of punishment that can ruin a life.
say:8:1623467007:1.source_cn: 你还是老样子，满口大道理……这些学生确实犯了错，但他们...

say:9:1623467008:1.text: One greedy mistake and you're done with magic forever? Even Zorya—and you know how strict she is—wouldn't call that fair.
say:9:1623467008:1.source_cn: 一次贪欲的后果就是赔上终生的魔法生涯？即便是以严格要求...

say:10:1623467009:1.text: They lost their magic. They lost everyone's trust. Now they're getting turned into a headline for people to laugh at. And they're still students, Reeo. Same as us. They haven't even finished school yet.
say:10:1623467009:1.source_cn: 他们损失了魔法能力，也失去了周围同学的信任，还被当成新...

say:11:1623467010:1.text: When someone's going under, they hold onto whatever they can reach. You of all people should get that.
say:11:1623467010:1.source_cn: 在水里挣扎的人总会想抓住目所能及的浮木，你该理解这种心情。

say:12:1623467011:1.text: Olaya, whatever they're holding onto, it's not real! And Bel's article is only going to make it worse. People are already starting to blame the school and magic itself. If this keeps going, we'll be tearing up our own foundations!
say:12:1623467011:1.source_cn: 奥莱雅，这根“浮木”是假的！巴布的那篇文章只会让情况更...

say:13:1623467012:1.text: And if they have nothing to hold onto, some of them won't make it through. Even if what they're holding onto isn't real...
say:13:1623467012:1.source_cn: 但如果连一点希望都没有，他们可能会撑不下去，哪怕这“希...

say:14:1623467013:1.text: Olaya, you know better than any of us.
say:14:1623467013:1.source_cn: 奥莱雅，你比我们都清楚。

say:15:1623467014:2.text: The only way out is to get them to remember why they loved magic in the first place. Those were your words.
say:15:1623467014:2.source_cn: 唯一的出路是让他们想起自己最初为何热爱魔法——这句话，...

say:16:1623467015:2.text: Olaya freezes. She opens her mouth like she's about to snap back, then nothing comes out. She looks down instead, fingers twisting the edge of her sleeve.
say:16:1623467015:2.source_cn: 奥莱雅愣住了，她张了张嘴，最终只是沉默地低下头，手指无...

say:19:1623467016:0.text: Right then, the host's voice carries across the plaza.
say:19:1623467016:0.source_cn: 而此时，主持人的声音传遍广场。

say:20:1623467017:1.source_cn: 各位请安静，研讨会即将开始！

say:1:1623469001:1.text: Thanks for showing up. If you're here, you probably care about what's right, so I appreciate that!
say:1:1623469001:1.source_cn: 感谢今天能到场的朋友，想必你们都是内心极其有正义感的人...

say:2:1623469002:1.text: He hasn't even finished the first sentence and the crowd is already clapping hard.
say:2:1623469002:1.source_cn: 巴布的开场白没说完，台下的掌声就热烈地响了起来。

say:3:1623469003:1.text: Lately, we've seen too many stories tearing into students with damaged mana. Calling them "failures", saying they "deserved it", turning their pain into something people gossip about over afternoon tea.
say:3:1623469003:1.source_cn: 在过去的一段时间里，我们看到了太多针对魔力受损者的不公...

say:4:1623469004:1.text: But today, I'm saying it straight. This was never their fault!
say:4:1623469004:1.source_cn: 但今天，在这里，我要说——这从来不是他们的错！

say:5:1623469005:1.text: How many nights have you laid awake thinking, if my magic was just a little stronger... would I've passed that selection? Would I be standing in the royal court right now?
say:5:1623469005:1.source_cn: 我们是否曾无数次在深夜思索——如果自己的魔力再强一点、...

say:6:1623469006:1.text: But is that desperation really because we're born not good enough? Or did something make us feel like we're always behind, always failing?
say:6:1623469006:1.source_cn: 可在这份近乎绝望的渴望背后，真的是我们与生俱来的无能吗...

say:7:1623469007:1.text: Magic has no limits. But every time we use it, it takes something from us. It's like a poison that corrodes us from the inside!
say:7:1623469007:1.source_cn: 魔力的增长没有上限，而我们的内心却被它不断掏空——因为...

say:8:1623469008:1.text: The tough competition at the Lyceum isn't protecting us. It's speeding up that corrosion!
say:8:1623469008:1.source_cn: 而莱希拉姆的残酷竞争制度，非但没有成为我们的护盾，反而...

say:9:1623469009:1.text: This anxiety about magic isn't something students should be dealing with on their own.
say:9:1623469009:1.source_cn: 魔法焦虑，其根源不应由年轻的学生独自背负。

say:10:1623469010:1.text: The real problem is the system. It says it's supposed to motivate us, but all it does is push us into cutthroat competition!
say:10:1623469010:1.source_cn: 真正的症结，在于这座学校所推行的、那种看似激励实则无情...

say:12:1623469011:0.text: The audience erupts in applause as Bel finishes speaking. The students cheer his name, hailing him as a hero who has awakened them. He stands above them, looking down at the fervent crowd with pride.
say:12:1623469011:0.source_cn: 演讲至此，台下掌声雷动，学生们高呼着巴布的名字，他宛如...

say:14:1623469012:1.text: The students fire questions at Bel, and he handles them effortlessly. His words stir up even more anger toward magic, fanning the flames of their growing resentment.

say:16:1623469013:2.source_cn: 当主持人宣布，互助团队发起人奥莱雅将以特邀嘉宾的身份出...

say:18:1623469014:1.text: But you notice something strange—Bel slips off the stage before the seminar ends. You decide to follow him, curious about what he's up to.

say:8:1623472008:0.source_cn: 走吧，希望它这次能派上用场。
say:8:1623472008:0.male: Let's go. I hope this thing works when we need it.
say:8:1623472008:0.female: Let's go. I hope this thing works when we need it.

say:10:1623472004:1.text: No, we need to act right now!
say:10:1623472004:1.source_cn: 不，我们得把握住这个时机！
say:10:1623472004:1.male: No, we need to act right now!
say:10:1623472004:1.female: No, we need to act right now!

choice:3:1:2.text: Let's head to school and get ready.
choice:3:1:2.male: Let's head to school and get ready.
choice:3:1:2.female: Let's head to school and get ready.

say:0:1623473001:0.text: Keep it down. Let's see where this goes.
say:0:1623473001:0.source_cn: 小声点，我们跟上去看看。
say:0:1623473001:0.male: Keep it down. Let's see where this goes.
say:0:1623473001:0.female: Keep it down. Let's see where this goes.

say:1:1623474001:1.text: Here's your payment... and hey, looks like it's working this time. We're getting somewhere.
say:1:1623474001:1.source_cn: 这是你们的酬劳……这次……效果不错。

say:0:1623474101:1.text: The merchant's voice is barely audible, fading in and out with the distance. You can only catch fragments.
say:0:1623474101:1.source_cn: 由于你们的距离较远，神秘商人的声音断断续续地传来，听不真切。
say:0:1623474101:1.male: The merchant's voice is barely audible, fading in and out with the distance. You can only catch fragments.
say:0:1623474101:1.female: The merchant's voice is barely audible, fading in and out with the distance. You can only catch fragments.

say:1:1623474102:1.text: You see the mystery merchant handing pouches of money to a handful of freelance reporters, and there's Bel, getting his share.
say:1:1623474102:1.source_cn: 你看到神秘商人将钱袋逐一递给几名外包记者，巴布也在其中。
say:1:1623474102:1.male: You see the mystery merchant handing pouches of money to a handful of freelance reporters, and there's Bel, getting his share.
say:1:1623474102:1.female: You see the mystery merchant handing pouches of money to a handful of freelance reporters, and there's Bel, getting his share.

say:1:1623474201:1.text: ... Bel... blame the school... Lyceum... stirring things up...
say:1:1623474201:1.source_cn: ……巴布……指向校方，莱希拉姆……搅乱……

say:2:1623474202:1.text: ... next time... Olaya... use her... rile them up...
say:2:1623474202:1.source_cn: 下次……奥莱雅……利用……推动情绪……

say:0:1623475001:0.text: There's too much background noise. We need to get closer!
say:0:1623475001:0.source_cn: 不行，我们离得太远，回音花记录的声音太模糊了，我们得靠近点！
say:0:1623475001:0.male: There's too much background noise. We need to get closer!
say:0:1623475001:0.female: There's too much background noise. We need to get closer!

say:1:1623477001:1.text: Don't worry, everything we've promised will be delivered. You'll get what's coming to you.
say:1:1623477001:1.source_cn: 不必有任何顾虑，我们做出的所有承诺都会一一兑现的。

say:2:1623477002:1.text: As long as you steer the Lyceum's public opinion in the way we want, we'll bump your pay up to the top tier, just like Bel's.
say:2:1623477002:1.source_cn: 只要按照我们要求的方向去引导莱希拉姆的舆论，你未来的酬...

say:3:1623477003:1.text: But... a lot of students have started questioning the value of magic because of the reports. I'm starting to feel... guilty about it.
say:3:1623477003:1.source_cn: 可是……最近确实有很多学生因为报道而质疑魔法的用处，我...

say:5:1623477004:1.text: Guilty? Those weaklings who can't handle their magic or the pressure—they don't belong in the Lyceum anyway!
say:5:1623477004:1.source_cn: 内疚？那些魔力受损、心理承受能力又差劲的废物，本来就不...

say:6:1623477005:1.text: They're just opportunistic losers looking for an easy way out. They should leave on their own and stay away from magic. It'll clean up our community!
say:6:1623477005:1.source_cn: 他们不过是一群渴望不劳而获的功利小人。他们就该主动选择...

say:7:1623477006:1.text: But Bel... didn't your articles always show sympathy for the mana-damaged students?
say:7:1623477006:1.source_cn: 可巴布你……你之前的文章不是一直站在同情那些魔力受损学...

say:8:1623477007:1.text: That's just the role I was hired to play. Money decides what I write—simple as that.
say:8:1623477007:1.source_cn: 那不过是这份工作的要求罢了。报酬的多少，直接决定了我的...

say:9:1623477008:1.text: And since we're being honest, those nasty hit pieces that dragged them through the mud? Yeah. I wrote those too.
say:9:1623477008:1.source_cn: 不怕告诉你们，之前那些丑化他们的爆款文章，也全都出自我手。

say:10:1623477009:1.text: Only rookies get all precious about "the truth". The smart ones just do whatever gets them paid.
say:10:1623477009:1.source_cn: 只有刚入行的新手，才会天真地死抱着所谓的“真相”不放。...

say:11:1623477010:1.text: That's how this business actually works.
say:11:1623477010:1.source_cn: 这，才是新闻行业的真正规则。

say:13:1623477011:1.text: Hah. I like you, Bel. You get it. We'll keep you on long-term.
say:13:1623477011:1.source_cn: 哈哈……巴布，我很欣赏你的想法，我们会长期找你合作的。

say:1:1623478001:1.text: They're colluding with outsiders, using the students' pain as bargaining chips!
say:1:1623478001:1.source_cn: 他们竟然……竟然勾结外人，将学生的痛苦当作筹码！
say:1:1623478001:1.male: They're colluding with outsiders, using the students' pain as bargaining chips!
say:1:1623478001:1.female: They're colluding with outsiders, using the students' pain as bargaining chips!

choice_prompt:2:1623478001.text: They're colluding with outsiders, using the students' pain as bargaining chips!
choice_prompt:2:1623478001.source_cn: 他们竟然……竟然勾结外人，将学生的痛苦当作筹码！
choice_prompt:2:1623478001.male: They're colluding with outsiders, using the students' pain as bargaining chips!
choice_prompt:2:1623478001.female: They're colluding with outsiders, using the students' pain as bargaining chips!

say:3:1623478002:1.text: Got it. Nice and clear. This is the kind of evidence they can't talk their way out of.
say:3:1623478002:1.source_cn: 当然，当然……这将是最有力的证据！
say:3:1623478002:1.male: Got it. Nice and clear. This is the kind of evidence they can't talk their way out of.
say:3:1623478002:1.female: Got it. Nice and clear. This is the kind of evidence they can't talk their way out of.

say:4:1623478003:1.text: You heard it too, right? Bel doesn't care what's true. He's just using students to make money, then leaving them to drown in the mess he creates!
say:4:1623478003:1.source_cn: 你也听到了，对吧？巴布他根本不在乎真相！他只不过是在利...
say:4:1623478003:1.male: You heard it too, right? Bel doesn't care what's true. He's just using students to make money, then leaving them to drown in the mess he creates!
say:4:1623478003:1.female: You heard it too, right? Bel doesn't care what's true. He's just using students to make money, then leaving them to drown in the mess he creates!

say:5:1623478004:1.text: I actually trusted him... I can't believe I fell for it!
say:5:1623478004:1.source_cn: 我当初竟然还对他抱有信任……我真是个傻瓜！
say:5:1623478004:1.male: I actually trusted him... I can't believe I fell for it!
say:5:1623478004:1.female: I actually trusted him... I can't believe I fell for it!

choice_prompt:6:1623478004.male: I actually trusted him... I can't believe I fell for it!
choice_prompt:6:1623478004.female: I actually trusted him... I can't believe I fell for it!

say:7:1623478005:1.text: Yeah. We'll definitely bring it out into the open.
say:7:1623478005:1.source_cn: 是的……我们得找个机会……一个能在公众面前揭露真相的机会。
say:7:1623478005:1.male: Yeah. We'll definitely bring it out into the open.
say:7:1623478005:1.female: Yeah. We'll definitely bring it out into the open.

choice_prompt:8:1623478005.male: Yeah. We'll definitely bring it out into the open.
choice_prompt:8:1623478005.female: Yeah. We'll definitely bring it out into the open.

say:9:1623478006:1.text: Yeah! Let them start the seminar. Then we walk up and lay it all out...
say:9:1623478006:1.source_cn: 没错！我们要让他们在自己准备的舞台上演砸这出戏……
say:9:1623478006:1.male: Yeah! Let them start the seminar. Then we walk up and lay it all out...
say:9:1623478006:1.female: Yeah! Let them start the seminar. Then we walk up and lay it all out...

say:10:1623478007:1.text: We'll pull their masks off right in front of everyone and expose the whole dirty scheme!
say:10:1623478007:1.source_cn: 我们要在所有人面前，撕下他们伪善的面具，把这场肮脏的骗...
say:10:1623478007:1.male: We'll pull their masks off right in front of everyone and expose the whole dirty scheme!
say:10:1623478007:1.female: We'll pull their masks off right in front of everyone and expose the whole dirty scheme!

say:12:1623478008:1.text: Reeo, still fuming, turns and walks away without a second glance.
say:12:1623478008:1.source_cn: 雷欧满腔怒火，头也不回地离开了。

choice:8:0:1.text: Then the next seminar. That's when we do it.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 下次研讨会是最佳时机
choice:8:0:1.male: Then the next seminar. That's when we do it.
choice:8:0:1.female: Then the next seminar. That's when we do it.

say:1:1623480001:1.female: Looks like things are moving forward.

say:3:1623480002:1.source_cn: 你们获取的信息很关键。

say:4:1623480003:1.text: We both know the Syndicate is behind the magic contracts and the speech loss outbreak. And now this? It's clearly targeting the mana-damaged students and the school's reputation.
say:4:1623480003:1.source_cn: 你我皆知，黑金商会是“魔力契约”与“失语症”的罪魁祸首...
say:4:1623480003:1.male: We both know the Syndicate is behind the magic contracts and the speech loss outbreak. And now this? It's clearly targeting the mana-damaged students and the school's reputation.
say:4:1623480003:1.female: We both know the Syndicate is behind the magic contracts and the speech loss outbreak. And now this? It's clearly targeting the mana-damaged students and the school's reputation.

say:5:1623480004:1.text: It's hard not to suspect this is the Syndicate's new plan after all their previous moves backfired. This time, they're being sneakier, and a lot more dangerous.
say:5:1623480004:1.source_cn: 很难不令人怀疑，这是黑金商会在前面几次行动受挫后的新策...

say:8:1623480006:1.text: Do we try to control the story, or do we just expose the whole thing? Shutting down the newspaper and blocking those reports sounds easy, but it's not the best approach.
